root_cause: Adaptive Delivery v1 evaluated risk rules in declaration order and stopped on the first match. A nested low-risk path such as brain/learning therefore inherited the broader brain/ R2 classification before its specific R0 rule could apply.
prevention_rule: For each changed path, evaluate all matching risk patterns and select the most-specific matching path rule first. After path classification, hot-path escalation remains authoritative and may only raise risk. Unknown executable surfaces remain fail-closed at R3.

evidence.observed: PR #3234 docs-only closure executed the full shared suite instead of the intended fast-impact route.
evidence.expected: brain/learning/* => R0 unless another changed path or hot-path escalation raises the aggregate risk.
tests: nested low-risk learning path overrides broader brain runtime rule
specific production workflow rule outranks broad .github governance rule
